gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's prices for TESmart's 8-port line on its own US store. On 2026-11-10 the HKS801-L23 cost $143.99 (marked down from $239.99), the HKS801-EB23 $229.00, the HKS801-P23 $399.00 and the HKS801-M24 $599.00. That puts the cheapest TESmart 8-port $26 under the AUTYUE card ChatGPT called the budget pick ($169.99). It also shows that ChatGPT's $399 'Upgraded 8 Port HDMI… USB 3.0' card is the P23, which costs $255.01 more than the L23. The extra money buys a 4K60 title and USB 3.0 in place of a 4K30 title.
standout_why: I compared against four rival pages. officekithq.com prints no prices, only 'Check price on Amazon' links. virtual-pc.com prints no prices. workcocoon.com reviews only 4-port units and gives price tiers instead of dollar amounts. dockgearhq.com (HDMI) names only the ATEN CS18208, with no price. mamalinux.com is the only one with dollar figures: MT-VIKI $114, ANGEET $129.99 and 'TESmart 8X1' $229 (the EB23), all undated. None of these pages lists the TESmart L23, P23 or M24 with a price, and none puts the TESmart ladder next to the AUTYUE and StarTech prices ChatGPT showed. mamalinux already has the EB23 at $229, so this is new and useful but not new on every point.
decides: The finding confirms the HKS801-P23 at $399 as the 4K60 + USB 3.0 + RS232/LAN pick and prices the steps around it. Buyers who can accept 4K30 can drop to the L23 at $143.99, which also undercuts ChatGPT's $169.99 AUTYUE budget card. Buyers who need above 60 Hz move up to the HDMI 2.1 M24 at $599. The EB23 at $229 is the weak rung: it costs $85.01 more than the L23 and still lists USB 2.0 and a 4K30 title.
candidates: AUTYUE 8 in 1 Out HDMI KVM (8 PCs, 1 monitor, 4K60, USB 3.0)
AUTYUE 8 Port HDMI/DisplayPort KVM (8 PCs, 2 monitors)
